small_guidance: Reduce register pressure to lift occupancy above 33%: shrink BLOCK_OC to 16 and BLOCK_SPATIAL to 32-64, hoist the IC loop outside the (kd,kh,kw) loops so weight loads are reused, and add @triton.autotune over {(BLOCK_OC,BLOCK_SPATIAL,num_warps,num_stages)} ∈ {(16,64,4,2),(32,32,4,2),(16,128,8,2),(32,64,8,3)}. Also fuse the BN affine (running mean/var folded into scale/shift) and the spatial-mean subtraction into a single epilogue kernel to remove the cudnn BN launch (~10% time).
large_guidance: Rewrite the conv-transpose as an input-stationary scatter-add GEMM: tile over (N, IC tile, input-spatial tile) and accumulate input×weight outer products into the output grid via atomic adds, eliminating the inner stride-divisibility masking and the IC loop's redundant weight reloads. Use channels_last5d layout so IC is the contiguous K-dim and OC is the contiguous N-dim of the implicit GEMM (BM=OC tile of 32-64, BK=IC of 16, BN=spatial tile). Fuse BN folding (precompute gamma/sqrt(var+eps), beta - gamma*mean/sqrt) and per-(N,OC) spatial-mean subtraction into a two-pass epilogue kernel that replaces both cudnn BN and the current bn_meansub kernel.
